newsitem.title: INDIA: At least 26 dead as India bus falls into ravine.
newsitem.headline: At least 26 dead as India bus falls into ravine.

text.p: At least 26 people were killed and 56 injured when a bus fell into a deep gorge in the northern Indian state of Himachal Pradesh, news agencies reported on Monday.

The accident occurred at Bhora village, 50 km (30 miles) northeast of the state capital Shimla, when the bus, run by the state transport corporation, veered off the road and rolled into a 300 metre-deep (1,000 ft) ravine.
The agencies said 21 people died on the spot while another five died on their way to the hospital.
The injured, some of them in serious condition, were taken to hospitals in Shimla, they said.
The precise cause of the accident has not been determined but overloading or brake failure were possible causes, the agencies said.
